# Derick Janssen

> Principal Engineer · Game Programmer at Santa Barbara Games. An award-winning gameplay programmer who has led teams of up to 12 engineers. Passionate about gameplay, feel, tools, performance, and multiplayer. Excels at rapid prototyping and communication.

The human-facing site and the PDF resume are the primary sources. The files below carry the same facts in plain text.

## Resume

- [Resume (Markdown)](/portfolio-site/resume.md): experience, team sizes, projects, skills, education
- [Resume (PDF)](/portfolio-site/resume.pdf): the designed resume
- [Portfolio home](/portfolio-site/): featured work, awards, contact

## Pages

- [Agentic AI workflows](/portfolio-site/agentic-ai/): At Santa Barbara Games, my agentic workflow lets 10 non-engineers ship pull requests. Everyone at the 12-person studio except the CFO and the community manager uses my tools.
- [Voidwood](/portfolio-site/projects/voidwood/): 1–4 player co-op survival horror. I own the deterministic multiplayer rollback netcode simulation, built on Unity ECS.
- [Rise of Elements](/portfolio-site/projects/rise-of-elements/): A PvP match-3 puzzle-battler with a PvE story mode — a faithful recreation of Force of Elements. I worked on nearly every part of the game except backend AWS server scaling.
- [ARK: Survival Ascended](/portfolio-site/projects/ark-survival-ascended/): Optimization, tools, and bug fixes on the Unreal Engine 5 remaster of ARK, including 25% more server performance in my first week.
- [Starfield](/portfolio-site/projects/starfield/): Feature lead for the StarMap. I later worked on Ship Building, Localization, Optimizations, and Outposts.
- [Fallout 76](/portfolio-site/projects/fallout-76/): Brought on to ship post-release features: bulldozing, vending, and CAMP decorating. I also worked on the Nuclear Winter battle-royale mode.
- [Skyrim VR](/portfolio-site/projects/skyrim-vr/): I spearheaded Skyrim VR from conception until launch, on both PSVR and Vive.
- [Fallout 4 VR](/portfolio-site/projects/fallout-4-vr/): I built VR melee, polished teleporting and movement, created the Workshop mode in VR, and many new UI elements in AS3.
- [Savage: Resurrection](/portfolio-site/projects/savage-resurrection/): A first- and third-person FPS/RTS hybrid. I did all of the commander coding, all of the combat and gun/spell logic, cosmetics, some UI, and character controls.
- [Strife](/portfolio-site/projects/strife/): A top-down 'second generation' MOBA with a ground-up reduced-toxicity design. I worked closely with designers and built ways for them to achieve what they wanted.
- [Chroma](/portfolio-site/projects/chroma/): A third-person multiplayer deathmatch with wall-walking on every level. Code-named Death Blossom.
- [Puppies In Spaaace!](/portfolio-site/projects/puppies-in-spaaace/): An all-ages first-person shooter. You play Puddles, a dog with shoulder-mounted tennis ball launchers, in a 3-stage boss battle against a vacuum cleaner piloted by a cat.
- [Cell](/portfolio-site/projects/cell/): A fast-paced 2D puzzle arcade shooter with RPG elements, started in Torque X 2D and converted to XNA.
- [Galactic Arms Race](/portfolio-site/projects/galactic-arms-race/): A multiplayer Diablo-esque looter shooter whose weapons are evolved by neural networks while you play. Also the thesis game for cgNEAT (content generation with AI).
- [JanssEngine](/portfolio-site/projects/janssengine/): My own engine and renderer, built from the ground up: dual OpenGL/DirectX renderer, Lua integration, my own JanScript language, LOD terrain, BSP with PVS, and hot-reloadable DLL plugins.
